builds.name: Dark Hexer
builds.description: A devastating hex build that abuses Dark Orb and Affinity to melt everything. Dark Souls 2's most powerful PvE caster, scaling with both Intelligence and Faith. The Sunset Staff with Dark BNS rings is unmatched.
builds.descriptionVi: Build hex hủy diệt với Dark Orb và Affinity. Pháp sư PvE mạnh nhất DS2, tăng theo cả Intelligence và Faith. Sunset Staff với nhẫn Dark BNS là không ai sánh bằng.

builds.name: Powerstance Curved Swords
builds.description: A powerstance build using dual curved swords for rapid-fire L1 attacks. Stunlocks enemies and procs bleed or poison in seconds. One of the highest sustained DPS setups in DS2.
